Practical and Sustainable
Unite assessment, development, and client insight on one AI-powered platform built for practitioners.
View Assessments
Request Demo
Assessments Designed for Development Work
Core Factors assessments are designed for development work, with results meant to be used as a starting point, not a final definition. Across emotional intelligence, interaction patterns, personality, and work and fit, Core Factors gives you a consistent way to help participants understand how patterns show up in real situations. The emphasis is on clarity, context, and ethical interpretation, so results support growth over time rather than becoming a box people feel stuck in.

MASTERING EMOTIONS
The Only EQ Assessment That Shows You Which Skills to Work on First
Most EQ assessments tell you where you stand. The 
EQ Accelerator
 tells you where to focus. By rating all 40 EQ skills on both Importance and Effectiveness, the assessment surfaces the gap between what matters most to your success and how well you are currently demonstrating it, then uses a weighted algorithm to identify the one skill per dimension worth developing right now. If your clients are using the EQ-i 2.0 or a similar profile-based tool, they are getting a snapshot. With the 
EQ Accelerator
, they get a development roadmap.
Learn more about EQ Accelerator
ELEVATE TEAMWORK
The Social Style Assessment Built Around Why People Interact, Not Just How They Behave
Most social style tools identify a pattern and stop there. 
Social Dynamics
 identifies four observable interaction styles, Mover, Mapper, Involver, and Integrator, and defines each one by five components: the core drive behind the behavior, the outcome the person is trying to achieve, their preferred decision-making approach, their cluster of strengths, and their typical behavioral patterns. The 28-page Style Navigator Report then goes further with a Things in Common layer that shows how styles connect and where they create friction across the four patterns. When participants understand not just their style but the intention behind it, the conversation moves from self-awareness to something they can apply in the next meeting.
Learn more about Social Dynamics
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
NAVIGATE WORK AND FIT
Career Assessments That Go Beyond Interest to Clarity
Most career assessments tell you what you are interested in. They deliver a three-letter code, a list of matching occupations, and leave the hard work of filtering to you and your client. 
Career Path
 independently scores both Preference and Avoidance across 11 Occupational Activity Groupings, so practitioners and clients can see not just where the energy is but where the friction will come from before a decision is made.
Many practitioners piece together career values work and motivational skills exploration using separate tools, card sorts, or conversation frameworks. 
Career Signals
 brings both into a single online assessment that produces a 12-page Work Motivation Profile covering what a client values most in their work and which skills energize versus drain them, scored and delivered through the Participant Hub without physical materials or facilitation overhead.
Learn more about Career Path
Learn more about Career Signals
UNLOCK SELF-KNOWLEDGE
Harnessing Jungian Psychological Type for Personal and Professional Growth
Type Discovery
 identifies the same 16 Jungian psychological types you already work with, using a non-forced-choice format with a built-in Type Precision Module for greater accuracy. Where the MBTI stops at a PDF report, Type Discovery delivers a complete participant experience and a practitioner platform built for development work. Your clients revisit their results, reflect, and continue the process long after the session ends.
Your client knows their four-letter code. But no other instrument reveals why two people with the same type show up so differently. 
Type Elements
 measures 32 subscales scored independently so patterns that other instruments average out become visible. When a subscale does not match the reported type, that is not an error. That is where life experience has shaped type expression.
Type Dynamics
 is the only instrument that puts the eight cognitive processes directly into the participant experience, so you can deliver type the way it was meant to be understood. The 13-page report does the teaching for you, making the cognitive process framework accessible and personal before participants ever see their results.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Complement any type assessment with 
YOU Type Effectiveness Reports
, 22-page development reports built around each of the 16 types, grounded in Center for Creative Leadership research and available directly from your Pro Account.
Learn more about Type Discovery
Learn more about Type Elements
Learn more about Type Dynamics

The 16 Personality Types: Profiles for Self-Discovery
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The 16 Personality Types: Profiles for Self-Discovery
$
19.95
 
 
Buy Now on Amazon.com

Booklets
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Description 
 
 
 
 Additional information 
 
 
 
 
 
Description
Those who thrive in both work and life share a set of transferable skills that include reading situations, managing their own reactions, and connecting with people who think and operate differently. These are key people skills, and they tend to develop most quickly when you understand how you naturally operate.
The 16 Personality Types: Profiles for Self-Discovery
 provides you with a clear picture of your natural pattern, captured in the four-letter personality type code. Your type code offers an in-depth look at how you think, decide, work, and connect. The sixteen type profiles are written so that you not only recognize yourself on the page but also learn about and see the people around you more clearly.
Each of the sixteen profiles pairs with guided reflection and a bridge into the four areas where people skills develop, so insight becomes something you can put into practice rather than just read about. Wherever you are with your type, whether you are a new or advanced learner, it meets you there and gives you something to work with.
Grounded in Carl Jung’s theory of psychological type and shaped by decades of combined experience in teaching, coaching, and developing teams and leaders, this booklet is built for practical, everyday use.
Turn what you learn into action you can apply right away, in the real-life situations that matter most.
Build on a dependable foundation you can return to as a catalyst for your development.
Go beneath the surface and understand the why behind how you operate.
Strengthen the relationships that matter, at work and at home.
Praise for 
The 16 Personality Types: Profiles for Self-Discovery
“A straightforward, clear and very helpful introduction to the 16-type model developed from Jung’s writings. The ‘pen portraits’ of each type are written with warmth and nuance. I found it personally helpful, and it brought new insights for me despite years of working with type.”
— Jerry Gilpin, President, British Association for Psychological Type
“The authors display an understanding of Jung’s original concerns and intentions. The profiles are smartly nuanced, deeply provocative, and singularly helpful to anyone wanting to keep the spirit of Jung alive in applying his typological model as a guide to everyday life.”
— Angelo Spoto, author of 
Jung’s Typology in Perspective
“These are some of the best explanations of Jung’s theory, the preferences, and type dynamics in a concise format that I have seen. How refreshing to find myself, and others, anew in the descriptions of the types. Bravo!”
— Cash Keahey, Keahey Consulting Group
“A beautiful and deceptively simple book. The familiar four-letter type is just the beginning, the code that unlocks the deeper architecture of personality. It gives my clients a deeper, evolving understanding of their natural patterns rather than reducing people to categories.”
— Deene Morris, MA, PCC, Leadership and Culture Coach
“A comprehensive and detailed self-awareness and self-reflection tool that takes people on a journey through understanding the 16 personality types in depth. The practical exercises bridge the gap between ‘knowing that’ and ‘knowing how.’ Overall an excellent guide.”
— Marion Kaiser, Director, People Culture and Safety

FREE DOWNLOAD
Download Why Does the Personality Instrument Matter?
Why Does the Personality Instrument Matter?
  by Mark S. Majors, PhD, delves into the significance of psychological assessments in facilitating self-discovery and personal growth. It highlights the critical role of psychometric properties, such as reliability and validity, in ensuring the effectiveness of personality instruments. The work emphasizes that these tools are not meant to judge an individual’s worth but to aid in better understanding oneself, fostering personal development, and enhancing interpersonal relationships.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Download now
Frequently Asked Questions
How is the Type Elements assessment administered?
 
 
 
The assessment is administered online through the 
Core Factors 
Pro Account
 using web-based electronic delivery. Practitioners create projects, add participants, and send secure links. Participants complete the 127 items online, and both Participant and Practitioner Reports are generated automatically and available electronically.
 
 
How much does Type Elements cost?
 
 
 
Type Elements
 assessment credits are available on a per-use basis through the 
Core Factors Pro Account.
 Current pricing is displayed on the product pricing page. The assessment produces a 15-17 page Participant Report plus a detailed Practitioner Report with numeric scores for professional interpretation.
 
 
What qualifications are required to administer the Type Elements assessment?
 
 
 
Professional administration requires one of three qualification paths: completion of relevant university coursework in psychological or educational tests and measures (U.S. Level B), license or certification from a board requiring appropriate training in ethical test use, or completion of the Core Factors practitioner training.
 
 
What is the Type Elements Practitioner Foundation Training?
 
 
 
The 
Type Elements
 Practitioner Foundation Training ($499) is led by Mark Majors, PhD and covers interpreting type subscales and response patterns, personality formation and advanced response analysis, and application and feedback techniques. It equips practitioners to deliver personalized, meaningful client feedback and support personal growth.
 
 
What is included with the Type Elements practitioner training?
 
 
 
The required coursework includes in-depth video lessons led by Mark Majors, PhD, covering subscale interpretation and formation scores, the
 Core Factors Type Elements
 assessment manual, and a competency assessment. Upon completion, you become an authorized user and gain access to the assessment.
 
 
What is included with a Pro Account?
 
 
 
A 
Pro Account
 provides access to assessments developed by experts, experience surveys, a project-based administration system, consignment links for easy participant access, on-screen and PDF reporting, and the ability to customize messaging. The
 Pro Account
 is free to apply for.
 
 
What reports are provided with Type Elements?
 
 
 
Type Elements 
provides two reports: a Participant Report (15-17 pages) with graphical results, subscale definitions, and Personality Formation statements accessible to non-professionals; and a Practitioner Report containing numeric scores for the 8 preferences, 32 subscales, 10 Personality Formation scores, and 8-Process information.
 
 
Why is the Practitioner Report separate from the Participant Report?
 
 
 
The Practitioner Report contains numeric information that requires professional interpretation to avoid confusion or misattribution. The Participant Report presents the same underlying data in graphical and verbal form, designed to be accessible and support self-discovery. This separation protects respondents from potentially confusing technical data.
 
 
Is there a participant portal or do participants only get a PDF?
 
 
 
Participants can access their results through the Participant Hub, providing an on-screen experience of their report that supports ongoing reflection. The detailed Participant Report can also be downloaded as a PDF for reference and sharing with practitioners during development conversations.
 
 
Can I use Type Elements with teams or only individuals?
 
 
 
Type Elements 
supports both individual and team applications. For individuals, it enables deep coaching and development conversations. For teams, the subscale and formation information helps understand diverse psychological types, improve communication, resolve conflicts, and build more effective collaboration based on individual differences.
